steps.purpose: The Recall names the machines already in your bay. Halloran needs the registry copied before the Authority closes it. Clear its guard and bring your company home.
steps.practice: Pause to choose your orders, then let the lance work together. After the drop, the company report points to repairs, crew training and salvage.

steps.purpose: The registry is safe, but its service trail is incomplete. A light scout can follow the western readers while the road guard stays on its station. This optional job opens a recovery claim.
steps.practice: Choose one fieldable scout in the manifest. A stock Gadfly fits this lift; use the planning map and Hold Fire to follow the western route.

steps.purpose: The trail leads to a stranded repair crew. Secure its cradle to earn a damaged workshop hulk. Holding the field can also preserve enemy machines for salvage, subject to recovery chance and your contract terms.
steps.practice: Build a smaller detail around the ground you must hold. After a successful return, inspect the hulk in the Workshop and price its rebuild before booking it.

steps.purpose: Your company carries the Authority's warrant into the field. The claim is written; your lance must make it enforceable while keeping its own machines in service.
steps.practice: Pause to choose your orders and watch the heat of your emitters. After the drop, review repair costs and crew experience before taking another warrant.

steps.purpose: The first warrant leaves a gap in the service record. One survey machine can record the western posts without destroying the road guard. This optional job locates a stranded service tender.
steps.practice: Choose one fieldable scout in the manifest. A stock Votive fits this lift; read the western posts with Hold Fire and weigh the optional ledger detour.

steps.purpose: The completed record locates a stranded service tender. Protect its transfer to earn replacement emitters. The company still pays for its own repairs, and any battlefield recovery follows the negotiated custody share.
steps.practice: Choose a smaller detail that can protect the loading stand. After a successful return, compare the delivered weapons with your current fittings before committing a refit.
